name: Skyvern
description: Automates browser workflows with LLMs and computer vision: logs in to portals, fills out forms, downloads files, and extracts structured data

name: Markus
description: Open-source AI workforce platform for building and running teams of AI agents with roles, task delegation, persistent memory, and inter-agent communication

name: Reel Agent
description: Self-hosted Telegram agent that breaks down short videos locally (Whisper transcript, OCR, extracted commands, repos and links) and plans and builds what they show with open models, asking on the phone before each shell command

name: CloseBench
description: Benchmark for AI sales agents that runs a complete agent (system prompt, tools, guardrails, state) through simulated WhatsApp sales conversations against an LLM-simulated buyer with a hidden budget; one lie, invented price, or ignored opt-out fails the scenario, the LLM judge is anchored on objective facts from mocked Stripe/SQLite, and results report pass^k and cost per conversation

name: Why is Codex browsing slow?
description: BrowseSprint's diagnostic guide to session controls, three baseline and three changed runs, and retaining failed outcomes

name: Personal Agent Bench
description: What nine public agent benchmarks (GAIA, BrowseComp, WebArena, OSWorld, tau-bench and others) measure, and what they leave out for personal agents

name: Browser Agent Blueprint
description: MIT-licensed browser-agent prompt modules with six reproducible synthetic browser demos for verification, retries, and resumable tasks

name: Colony Lab Findings
description: Reproducible probes from a long-running AI agent society: memory injection, reasoning budgets, timeouts

name: localscreenshot
description: Screenshot API that turns any public page into an image or a PDF, from 227 countries, with cookie banners, ads and chat widgets hidden

name: Looot Network
description: Open source alternative to Happenstance: search your own LinkedIn, Google Contacts or CSV network in plain language

name: Fuuga
description: LLM pipeline built from scratch in F# on TorchSharp: BPE tokenizer training, pre-training, LoRA/QLoRA/DPO fine-tuning, weight import from Hugging Face and GGUF models, RAG-grounded generation and an OpenAI-compatible server
